question: Who among the following is famous for playing the musical instrument 'Sitar'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vilayat Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Khan:-**

 
 
• He was a prominent Sitar player.
 
• He was born on 28 August 1928 in Gouripur in East Bengal, now Bangladesh.
 
• He invented a new technique of playing Sitar with the left hand which lasts for longer consistency.
 
• He also invented many Ragas enriching Indian Music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zakir Hussain:-**

 
 
• He is a world-renowned tabla player, composer, and percussionist.
 
• He was born on March 9, 1951, in Mumbai, India. Zakir Hussain comes from a family of renowned musicians, and his father, Ustad Allah Rakha, was also a legendary tabla player.
 
 
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan:-**
 
 
• He was one of the most celebrated and influential musicians in the world of Indian classical music.
 
• He was born on April 14, 1922, in the village of Shibpur, in present-day Bangladesh, and he passed away on June 18, 2009, in San Anselmo, California, USA.
